Built by Underwriters, for Underwriters Real-Time P&C Underwriting Suite

Facio’s smart P&C module puts every revenue-critical workflow on one screen. Interactive risk gauges deliver real-time risk analysis as you key the quote, so underwriters hit target loss ratios with confidence. A built-in insurance billing center supports ACH, card, split payments, and pay-in-installments, capturing premium the moment the bind button is pressed. Your clients see the same data in an AI-powered customer portal that answers coverage questions, collects documents, and pushes status alerts 24/7. Need proof of cover on site? Generate an instant Certificate of Insurance with digital signature and unique policy number in seconds. From quote to cash, every action feeds Facio’s compliance engine, producing regulator-ready bordereaux and audit logs automatically. One cloud-native stack, purpose-built to run profitable P&C programs faster, smarter, and without compromise.
